record.oneLiner: A crested duck-billed hadrosaur of Late Cretaceous Alberta.
record.description: Corythosaurus was a lambeosaurine 'duck-billed' hadrosaur about 8–9 m long, famous for its tall, hollow, helmet-like head crest. The crest most likely amplified calls, working like a resonating trombone. It is known from many complete specimens, some with preserved skin.

notableFacts.text: Its hollow crest likely resonated to produce calls, like a trombone.
Some specimens preserve impressions of its polygonal scales.
